name: sunlit_broadleaf_forest
placement_grid: Even 16px block columns and rows only; each cell fills a whole 2x2 group.
bit_means: Neighbouring 32x32 cell is outside the forest.
diagonal_rule: Discard a diagonal bit when either of its adjacent cardinal bits is set. normalize(mask) produces one of 47 masks.
selection: The three variants can be mixed. Their outer five pixels use the same base. Pick matching neighbour masks; never mirror directional light.
